T.gu: For grown-ups: how it works in Georgia
T.guText: In Fulton County, each city decides zoning inside its limits after a public hearing, and the county decides in the few unincorporated areas left. If land is already zoned for a use, there may be no hearing. Development authorities decide local tax breaks. Large projects also get a regional review that only gives advice. State bodies handle other parts. The Georgia Public Service Commission sets power rates but does not pick sites. Georgia EPD issues air permits for backup generators and permits for large water use. The game uses made-up boards so it stays clear of elections.
